build_custom_glu_activation: build a CustomGLU module that applies a gated linear unit with a custom activation function like sigmoid
create_swiglu_layer: create a SwiGLU activation layer that applies SiLU gated linear unit to split input tensors
create_geglu_layer: create a GeGLU activation layer that applies GELU gated linear unit to split input tensors
create_reglu_layer: create a ReGLU activation layer that applies ReLU gated linear unit to split input tensors
use_get_activation_fn: use get_activation_fn to map a string like swiglu to its corresponding GLU activation class
